messages:
alex: Morning quick poll — teleportation for commutes (instant) or instant 10-minute power naps that fully refresh you? pick one. :thinking:
brett: teleportation all day. no more bridge traffic :raised_hands:
maria: naps please. flights are way less awful when you can reset mid-day :zzz:
jamal: teleportation. lunch with the folks in another city in 5 mins? yes please.
sophia: naps for me. the ritual + immediate refresh sounds lovely.
brett: plus teleportation has so many logistic questions. do you teleport into the office? security? :joy:
alex: valid. teleportation might need extra HR rules :grimacing:
sophia: can we make teleportation a paid tier so i can upgrade my commute? :money_with_wings:
maria: poll time — react with :one: for teleportation, :two: for naps
alex: adding reactions... :one::two:
jamal: voting :one: — time saved is the win, especially on meeting-heavy days.
maria: naps = fewer afternoon sugar binges for me, so i'm team :two:
brett: tie-breaker? whoever brings the best snack gets the opposite vote :wink:
alex: final tally from reactions: :one: 3 votes, :two: 3 votes — perfect tie. guess we need a face-off IRL :tada:
